rawInput.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dual_rw.sh - Simulates dual read/write during migration.
# Appends a timestamped line to dual_rw.log on each run.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/dual_rw.log"

printf '%s | dual read/write OK\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Logged dual read/write event to $LOG_FILE"
